title: Backups and database names
description: Return only successful backups together with the database name. Return exactly three columns: backup_id, database_name, size_mb. Sort by backup_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT b.id AS backup_id, d.name AS database_name, b.size_mb
FROM backups AS b
hints: Join backups to databases by database_id.
status belongs to the backups table.
solution_explanation: Filtering after the correct JOIN keeps only successful backups.
